Third-party notice: tiptap-editor.js (vendored editor bundle)
=============================================================

File: app/static/vendor/tiptap-editor.js
Built: 2026-11-13, one minified IIFE (esbuild 0.28.2), sets window.TiptapEditor.
Exports: Editor, Node, Extension, mergeAttributes, Document, Paragraph, Text, History (alias UndoRedo).

Licence: every package below is under the MIT licence (read from each package.json on 2026-11-13). The MIT
licence texts, with the copyright line of each package, are reproduced in the section "Licence texts"
at the end of this file (copied verbatim from each package's LICENSE file). No paid, pro or cloud package is used
(nothing under @tiptap-pro or @tiptap-cloud).

Build tool only (not shipped): esbuild 0.28.2, MIT, https://www.npmjs.com/package/esbuild/v/0.28.2

Notes
-----
- @tiptap/extension-undo-redo does not exist on the npm registry; undo/redo uses @tiptap/extension-history at the
  same 3.33.1 version (the brief's fallback).
- The bundle is built outside the repo. The repo has no package.json or node_modules; nothing here is installed by
  the application.

How to rebuild
--------------
The build directory is a scratch folder outside the repo (for example
<scratchpad>/tiptap-build). In it:

  npm init -y
  npm install --save-exact @tiptap/core@3.33.1 @tiptap/pm@3.33.1 @tiptap/extension-document@3.33.1 @tiptap/extension-paragraph@3.33.1 @tiptap/extension-text@3.33.1 @tiptap/extension-history@3.33.1 @tiptap/extensions@3.33.1
  npm install --save-dev --save-exact esbuild@0.28.2
  npx esbuild entry.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' --outfile="<repo>/app/static/vendor/tiptap-editor.js"

entry.js (the only source of the bundle):

  import { Editor, Node, Extension, mergeAttributes } from "@tiptap/core";
  import { Document } from "@tiptap/extension-document";
  import { Paragraph } from "@tiptap/extension-paragraph";
  import { Text } from "@tiptap/extension-text";
  import { History } from "@tiptap/extension-history";

  window.TiptapEditor = {
    Editor, Node, Extension, mergeAttributes, Document, Paragraph, Text, History, UndoRedo: History,
  };
